pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Complex polygonal geometries with high-frequency, jagged edge serrations. Individual dark regions on the flank exhibit star-like radial extensions with sharp pixel-level gradients along the margins.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous topological graph of light-colored pelage with relatively narrow and uniform pixel thickness. Intersection nodes consist primarily of trivalent junctions separating the star-shaped dark patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Continuous 1D contour along the dorsal neck with a high-frequency, low-amplitude serrated profile visible against the background.
